snippet.title: ARIDA 2: Rise of The Brave - EN [ Gameplay Teaser ]
snippet.description:
ARIDA 2: Rise of The Brave : Join Cícera on an emotional journey through a vibrant yet hostile world. Uncover the secrets of a promised land, solve quests, and master crafting to survive. In the 19th-century Brazilian backlands, your courage is the only weapon against the drought!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212030/ARIDA_2_Rise_of_the_Brave
